'''Thugo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] merchant who lived on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He had a small shop on the Lower Promenade, where he sold equipment modifications.
